human.name: Perception
human.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

human.name: Mace Specialization
human.description: Mace and two-handed mace skill is increased by 5.

human.name: Sword Specialization
human.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 2% while you have a sword or two-handed sword equipped.

human.name: Will to Survive
human.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Stun effects.

dwarf.name: Stoneform
dwarf.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

dwarf.name: Find Treasure
dwarf.description: Instant. Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap.  Lasts until canceled.

dwarf.name: Mace Specialization
dwarf.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 1% while you have a mace or two-handed mace equipped.

dwarf.name: Big Game Hunter
dwarf.description: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

night-elf.name: Shadowmeld
night-elf.description: Instant, 10 sec cooldown. Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

night-elf.name: Quickness
night-elf.description: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.

night-elf.name: Wisp Spirit
night-elf.description: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

night-elf.name: Elune's Light
night-elf.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

gnome.name: Escape Artist
gnome.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

gnome.name: Expansive Mind
gnome.description: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%, whichever your class uses.

gnome.name: Engineering Specialization
gnome.description: Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the rate of engineering devices failing or backfiring when you use them by 20%.

gnome.name: Eureka!
gnome.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Your next 3 damaging abilities cost less (50% less Mana, 40% less Rage, 20% less Energy; 15% less Mana for healers, who also heal 10% more) and deal 10% more damage.

orc.name: Blood Fury
orc.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

orc.name: Axe Specialization
orc.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities by 1% while you have an axe or a two-handed axe equipped.

orc.name: Command
orc.description: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets is increased by 5%.

orc.name: Hardiness
orc.description: Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.

orc.name: Shatter Curse
orc.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 15% for 8 sec.

undead.name: Will of the Forsaken
undead.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

undead.name: Cannibalize
undead.description: 5 yd range, Instant, 2 min cooldown. When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

undead.name: Underwater Breathing
undead.description: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.

undead.name: Touch of the Grave
undead.description: Your spells and attacks have a chance (5% for casters, 10% for melee) to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health. 1 sec internal cooldown.

tauren.name: War Stomp
tauren.description: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

tauren.name: Cultivation
tauren.description: Instant, 1 hour cooldown. Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once.

tauren.name: Endurance
tauren.description: Total Health increased by 5% and chance to hit increased by 1%.

tauren.name: Plainsrunning
tauren.description: Gain 1% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 30% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect.

troll.name: Berserking
troll.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.

troll.name: Beast Slaying
troll.description: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

troll.name: Regeneration
troll.description: Health regeneration rate increased by 10%. In addition, 10% of total Health regeneration will continue during combat.

troll.name: Throwing Specialization
troll.description: Throwing weapon skill is increased by 5.

troll.name: Rapid Regeneration
troll.description: Channeled, 3 min cooldown. Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

skyborne-horde.name: Walk on Air
skyborne-horde.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

skyborne-horde.name: Skysight
skyborne-horde.description: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Attempt to draw power from a convergence of elements and receive its blessing, increasing your movement and mounted movement speeds by 10%. Lasts 30 sec if no elemental convergence is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.

skyborne-horde.name: Wind Blessed
skyborne-horde.description: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 1%.

skyborne-horde.name: Elemental Insight
skyborne-horde.description: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

skyborne-alliance.name: Walk on Air
skyborne-alliance.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

skyborne-alliance.name: Read Ley Line
skyborne-alliance.description: 2 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Attempt to tap into the power of a nearby ley line, increasing your Health and Mana regeneration by 100%. Lasts 15 sec if no ley line is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.

skyborne-alliance.name: Wind Blessed
skyborne-alliance.description: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 1%.

skyborne-alliance.name: Elemental Insight
skyborne-alliance.description: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.
